rca:flags.text: 2 of 9 upcasts found in the profiler data do not match a profile in the official index.
Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (30770 scans, 27908 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Niskin 17 (SAL-141, ~100 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle -0.0189 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.004 PSU/m.
Niskin 23 (SAL-142, ~10 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle +0.0682 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.008 PSU/m.
Niskin 17 (SAL-141, ~100 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.0232 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.004 PSU/m.
Niskin 23 (SAL-142, ~10 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle +0.0654 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.012 PSU/m.
Autosal workbook header date is 2022-10-25 but the cast is on 2022-08-23; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
